This durable air powered staple gun delivers high-quality performance for your next heavy duty mesh and woven projects, such as electrified single wire with insulation, horse and deer fencing, and chain link fencing. Optimized airflow and upgraded internal parts provide increased power with less air consumption, while also allowing for quick and easy repairs.
